turns.message: Give me all your policy information.
turns.answer:
Returns: unused bikes may be returned within 30 days of delivery, with free return shipping, if they are in the original box with all parts and have been ridden less than 50 km; refunds follow warehouse inspection, and a support agent confirms the outcome. Warranty covers frames for 5 years for the original owner, forks, wheels and components for 2 years, and Ridge E batteries and motors for 2 years or 500 charge cycles, whichever comes first; crash damage, normal wear and modifications are excluded, and frame damage or battery problems require inspection by the service team—stop riding and contact support. Care guidance is to clean and lube the chain every 200 km or after rain, check tyre pressure weekly, tighten thru-axles to their printed torque and service annually; Ridge E batteries should be charged indoors at room temperature with the original charger, stored at 30–60% charge if unused for over a month, and kept away from pressure washers, with brake pads checked every 500 km. Sizing: S 155–167 cm, M 167–178 cm, L 178–189 cm, XL 189–200 cm; choose smaller between sizes for agility or larger for stability, and Metro C is available only in S, M and L.

Sources: returns_policy_2026.md, care_general.md, warranty.md, care_ridge_e.md, sizing_guide.md
